title: Implement chart, dashboard, and report components per @objectstack/spec
body:
Completes the @objectstack/spec implementation for dashboard, chart, and report components. Adds missing chart types, metric cards, report builder/viewer functionality, and comprehensive Storybook documentation.

## Chart Types

Added pie, donut, radar, and scatter charts to `AdvancedChartImpl`:

```typescript
// All registered as standalone types
'pie-chart' | 'donut-chart' | 'radar-chart' | 'scatter-chart'

// Or via unified chart component
{ type: 'chart', chartType: 'pie' | 'donut' | 'radar' | 'scatter' }
```

Implementation uses Recharts components (`PieChart`, `RadarChart`, `ScatterChart`) with proper color palette cycling and chart-specific configurations (innerRadius for donut, PolarGrid for radar).

## Dashboard Components

**MetricCard** - Standalone KPI card with Lucide icon support and trend indicators:

```typescript
{
  type: 'metric-card',
  title: 'Total Revenue',
  value: '$45,231.89',
  icon: 'DollarSign',
  trend: 'up',           // up/down/neutral with color coding
  trendValue: '+20.1%'
}
```

## Report Components

**ReportViewer** - Renders report sections (header, summary, chart, table, text, page-break) with toolbar for export/print. Handles data aggregation for summary fields.

**ReportBuilder** - Enterprise-grade interactive report configuration UI with comprehensive features:

- **5 Tabbed Sections** for organized configuration:
  - **Basic Tab**: Title, description, data source selection, and export options
  - **Fields Tab**: Field selection with label customization, aggregation types (sum, avg, min, max, count, distinct), and summary display control
  - **Filters Tab**: Complete filter builder with 8 operators (equals, not_equals, contains, greater_than, less_than, between, in, not_in)
  - **Group By Tab**: Grouping configuration with custom labels and sorting (ascending/descending)
  - **Sections Tab**: Report section builder supporting all section types (header, summary, chart, table, text, page-break)
- **Export Configuration**: Support for PDF, Excel, CSV, JSON, and HTML formats with toggle controls
- **Live Preview**: Real-time preview of report configuration
- **Save/Cancel Handlers**: Complete workflow management

Both components fully implement `ReportViewerSchema` and `ReportBuilderSchema` from spec, with ReportBuilder now supporting all `ReportSchema` protocol features including filters, groupBy, sections, and export configurations.

## Storybook Documentation

Added comprehensive interactive examples for all new components:

- **`charts.stories.tsx`** - Added Pie, Donut, Radar, and Scatter chart examples
- **`dashboard.stories.tsx`** - Added MetricCard and chart combination layouts
- **`metric-card.stories.tsx`** - 8 examples showcasing icons, trends, and variations
- **`reports.stories.tsx`** - 4 examples for ReportViewer and enhanced ReportBuilder (with pre-populated configurations demonstrating all features)

Total of 20+ interactive Storybook stories added for visual documentation and testing.

## Files Changed

- `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` - Chart type implementations
- `packages/plugin-charts/src/index.tsx` - Component registrations
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/{MetricCard,ReportViewer,ReportBuilder}.tsx` - New components
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ReportBuilder.tsx` - Enhanced with tabbed interface and complete protocol support
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx` - Component registrations
- `packages/components/src/stories-json/charts.stories.tsx` - Chart examples
- `packages/components/src/stories-json/dashboard.stories.tsx` - Dashboard examples
- `packages/components/src/stories-json/metric-card.stories.tsx` - MetricCard examples
- `packages/components/src/stories-json/reports.stories.tsx` - Enhanced report examples

## Testing

- ✅ 16 tests passing (enhanced test coverage for ReportBuilder)
- ✅ Build passes without errors
- ✅ Full TypeScript support
- ✅ Complete @objectstack/spec protocol compliance
